sections.heading: 7.2. Complaint Requirements
sections.content: The MCO must maintain complaint procedures and must notify the enrollee of decisions.

subsections.heading: 7.2.1. First Level Complaint Process
subsections.content: The MCO must send a first level complaint acknowledgment letter and complete review within thirty (30) calendar days.

subsections.heading: 7.2.2. Second Level Complaint Process
subsections.content: The MCO must permit a second level complaint and must complete review within forty five (45) calendar days.
